description: Evaluate whether a shopper can get an offer’s price, given what you know about them: memberships, location, app or store purchase, first order, coupon clipping, Subscribe & Save and order total. Anything not supplied stays unknown and makes the verdict "uncertain" rather than "eligible".

first_order.description: Whether this would be the shopper’s first order at the retailer.

in_store.description: Whether the shopper will buy in a store.

memberships.description: Programmes the shopper holds: amazon_prime, walmart_plus, target_circle_360, target_circle_card, costco_member, sams_club, kohls_rewards, student, store_card. Omit if unknown.

order_total.description: Expected order total, for minimum-spend conditions.

uses_app.description: Whether the shopper will buy in the retailer’s app.

will_clip.description: Whether the shopper will clip an on-page coupon.

will_subscribe.description: Whether the shopper accepts Subscribe & Save.

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility
